Population increased in Bradford

The estimated population of Bradford in 2024 was 563,605 usual residents, a rise of 0.8% since 2023.

This meant that Bradford's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Bradford increased by 3.1%.

Over this slightly longer period, Bradford was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Bradford

The average (median) age stayed at 36.9 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Bradford has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Bradford is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Bradford's population of 563,605 usual residents was made up of:

  • 125,834 people aged 0 to 15 years, (22.3%)
  • 350,274 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62.1%)
  • 87,497 people aged 65 years and over, (15.5%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Bradford has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (22.3% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Bradford, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Bradford
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Bradford, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 2,063 people (0.4%). In total, there were 6,950 births and 4,887 deaths in Bradford.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 5,628 (-1%). There were 19,219 people entering the area and 24,847 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Bradford's population of 8,099 (1.4%) as a result of 11,811 people entering the area and 3,712 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Bradford was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Bradford in mid-2023 is 559,071.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 196 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 1,319 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 1,123 people.
